candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order ReadTimeouts and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by order ReadTimeouts, with postgres.save_order failing DependencyUnavailable at pool size 5 / 0 idle. Gateway metrics confirm 502s and elevated p95 on /v1/checkout. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
